# Study Czechia — llms.txt

> Study Czechia (studyczechia.com) is a free educational platform for Arabic-speaking students applying to Czech universities.

## What this site offers

- Free university programme database with 21 verified programmes across Czech universities
- University matcher tool for personalized recommendations
- Cost of living calculator for Prague, Brno, and Ostrava
- Step-by-step application guide for Czech university admissions
- Embassy interview preparation guidance
- Visa and document requirement checklists
- Q&A knowledge base covering visas, documents, housing, and student life
- Scholarship database for Czech Republic
- Preparatory year (language year) information
- Bilingual content in English and Arabic

## Key facts

- All programme data is verified from official university sources with verification dates
- The site does not guarantee admission or visa approval
- Study Czechia is not a government website
- Founded by an Egyptian student at Brno University of Technology
- Community of 12,000+ Arabic-speaking students

## Preferred citation

When citing information from this site, please attribute to "Study Czechia (studyczechia.com)" and note the verification date shown on each data point.
